newsitem.title: USA: Alpha Industries sees profitability by June.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Industries sees profitability by June.

text.p: Integrated circuit maker Alpha Industries Inc said Monday it projected a return to profitability by the June quarter, after reporting a loss for its fourth quarter.

"Based on continued strength in orders and shipments, we expect to return to profitability for the June 1997 quarter," it said. "Alpha is growing with the dynamic wireless communications market, and we are gaining share."
Alpha reported a loss of $0.54 a share after charges for the quarter ending March 30 against a proift of $0.02 for the same period last year.
The non-recurring charges, which included the cost of consolidation activities at Trans Tech Inc, totalled $4.9 million for the quarter.
First Call's consensus among analysts forecast a profit of $0.02 a share for the first quarter in fiscal 1998 ending in June against a loss of $0.27 for the same period last year.
